# `tools.yml` keys

Source: [`schema/tools.schema.json`](../../schema/tools.schema.json), which
editors with the YAML language server use for completion; `lib/tap/config.rb`
enforces the same rules.

Top level: `publisher` (the WinGet publisher name) and `tools`, a mapping
from each tool's name (`[a-z0-9-]+`) to the keys below.

| Key | Required | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repo` | yes | string | GitHub repository that publishes the releases. |
| `desc` | yes | string | Homebrew description: at most 80 characters, no final period, no leading article, does not start with the tool's name. |
| `license` | yes | string | SPDX expression. |
| `binaries` | yes | list of strings | Executables inside the archives (without .exe). |
| `test` | yes | list of strings | Arguments that make the first binary print its version. |
| `verify` | yes | `checksum` or `attestation` | attestation: every archive needs a SLSA provenance from a workflow of repo. checksum: SHA-256 only. |
| `checksums` | yes | string | Checksums file attached to each release. |
| `assets` | yes | object | Archive name per platform; {version} is the version without v. |
| `caveats` | no | string | Text Homebrew and Scoop print after the install. |
| `completions` | no | list of strings | Arguments that make the first binary print a completion script; the shell's name is appended. |
| `nested` | no | boolean | The macOS and Linux archives wrap their files in one directory named after the archive (cargo-dist does). |
| `pin` | no | string | Serve exactly this release instead of the latest (written by bin/tap rollback; quote it). |
| `formula` | no | string | Homebrew formula name when the tool's name is taken in homebrew-core (Formula/&lt;formula&gt;.rb). |
| `conflicts` | no | list of strings | Formulae that install the same binaries (conflicts_with in the formula). |
| `winget` | no | string | WinGet package identifier (Publisher.Name); needs the top-level publisher. |

Platforms of `assets`: `darwin_amd64`, `darwin_arm64`, `linux_amd64`, `linux_arm64`, `windows_amd64`, `windows_arm64`.
